use http::{HeaderMap,HeaderValue,Request};
fn main(){
 let mut input=std::collections::HashMap::new();input.insert("x-check".to_string(),"seven".to_string());
 let mut headers=HeaderMap::<HeaderValue>::try_from(&input).unwrap();
 headers.entry("x-check").or_insert(HeaderValue::from_static("eight"));
 assert_eq!(headers["x-check"],"seven");
 let name="x-other".parse::<http::header::HeaderName>().unwrap();
 headers.entry(&name).or_insert(HeaderValue::from_static("nine"));
 let error:http::Error="bad\n".parse::<HeaderValue>().unwrap_err().into();
 assert!(error.is::<http::header::InvalidHeaderValue>());
 let request=Request::builder().uri("https://example.com/a?b=c").body(()).unwrap();
 println!("{} {} {}",headers["x-check"].to_str().unwrap(),headers[&name].to_str().unwrap(),request.uri());
}
